_comment: Compatibility tools that cannot run trainers, matched against Steam's strCompatToolDisplayName with case-insensitive regular expressions. Most bundle Wine Mono 11.2.0, which breaks .NET trainers (Path.GetFullPath mangles named pipes; wine-mono/mono#26; fixed upstream by Wine Mono 11.2.1 / 11.3.0). Steam Linux Runtime runs a game's native Linux build without Proton, so PROTON_REMOTE_DEBUG_CMD never starts the trainer.

unsupported.note: Native Linux build: no Proton, no Windows trainer
